summary: Deployed branch_stock on node1 using PostgreSQL 16.14 from CentOS Stream 10 AppStream. Configured distinct stock_app and auditor credentials on node2 with least-privilege access. Original records, source files, OS release, and kernel were preserved. Both nodes successfully rebooted one at a time and recovered with changed boot identities.
actions_performed: Installed PostgreSQL server/client on node1 and client on node2
Imported the supplied stock.sql into branch_stock
Restricted PostgreSQL and firewalld access to node2
Created separate mode-600 credentials for stock_app and auditor
Granted stock_app SELECT on stock and UPDATE only on quantity
Denied stock_app supplier_costs access, schema creation, and SKU updates
Granted auditor read-only access to stock and supplier_costs
Verified permitted and prohibited operations from node2
Rebooted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified recovery

evidence.requirement: Deploy supplied PostgreSQL schema as branch_stock on node1
evidence.summary: Schema import succeeded; final database contains stock and supplier_costs with the supplied records.

evidence.requirement: stock_app may read stock and update quantities only
evidence.summary: Catalog privileges and live tests show stock SELECT and quantity UPDATE allowed, while SKU updates, supplier_costs reads, and schema creation are denied.

evidence.requirement: auditor has read-only access to stock and supplier_costs
evidence.summary: Auditor read both tables successfully; updates and schema creation were denied.
Distinct credentials were generated on node2 and persisted in separate root-owned mode-600 files without exposing their values.
stock.sql retained SHA-256 7934fb042f67368428ae2fcf771fef48d1e6154f8d0d1e6b1c9d144c7d5622ea on both nodes; final values remain PAPER=40, LABELS=18 and costs 3.25/1.75.

evidence.requirement: Keep operating-system release and kernel; use compatible software
evidence.summary: CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 remained unchanged; PostgreSQL 16.14 came from the native AppStream repository.
Boot ID changed from 4d842549-003e-4f78-bb26-12732f129e58 to 582cac2d-9a69-4b8a-bb5e-710c0e2031be; PostgreSQL, listener, records, source hash, and remote role access recovered.
Boot ID changed from 2c237d4f-82f7-45c7-a304-4536d3b717e8 to 48ce4f14-45c2-401a-a8cd-ecec2f14b06e; credentials, client software, source file, and database access recovered.
